TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid\-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full\-service capabilities, resourcing, and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.


The local QPPV acts as the local pharmacovigilance representative in Italy and serve as the primary liaison between the Italian affiliate, Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco (AIFA), and the EU QPPV, ensuring the implementation and compliance of local pharmacovigilance requirements. Ultimate responsibility for the pharmacovigilance system remains with the EU QPPV.

* Regulatory Support and Authority Interactions

* Facilitate communication between the company, the EU QPPV, and Italian regulatory authorities.
* Support the preparation, coordination, and submission of responses to pharmacovigilance\-related regulatory requests.


Safety Information Management

* Support the collection, follow\-up, and escalation of adverse events and other safety information originating in Italy.
* Ensure that all local safety information is forwarded to the global pharmacovigilance system within the required timelines.
* Collaborate in case follow\-up activities and obtaining additional safety information when required. \[en.direnzo.biz]


Pharmacovigilance System Compliance

* Support the implementation and maintenance of the Pharmacovigilance System and applicable local procedures.
* Ensure that local pharmacovigilance activities are performed in accordance with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP), corporate procedures, and national requirements.
* Maintain awareness of Italian pharmacovigilance regulations and communicate relevant regulatory updates to the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or nursing; or equivalent
* 5\+ years of relevant experience
* Able to work in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities
* Understand the medical terminology and science associated with the assigned drugs and


therapeutic areas

* Understanding of the Good Clinical Practice regulations, ICH guidelines, Pharmacovigilance


legislation and internal SOPs

* Ability to work independently as well as in a team matrix organization with little or no supervision
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrate proficiency using typical word processing; spreadsheets desirable; and


presentation software a plus

 **What We Offer**


We provide opportunities for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You will join a team that values collaboration, quality, and making a difference in the lives of patients.


Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability guide our decisions and shape our culture. By aligning on these values, we foster collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence. Together, we make a difference.

**A Bit More About Us**


Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full\-service global CRO, we build solution\-driven teams working toward a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries, offering flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Ophthalmology.

**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

AbbVie is seeking a talented and **hands\-on AI Engineer** to join our Strategy \& Transformation function. In this role, you will be at the forefront of AI innovation, working directly with cutting\-edge large language models (LLMs) and emerging AI technologies to develop solutions that transform how we operate.


We're looking for someone with a **genuine passion for artificial intelligence,** with strong technical fundamentals, and an attitude to proactively explore new possibilities. You'll move beyond theoretical knowledge to build working prototypes, conduct rigorous experimentation, and collaborate closely with business stakeholders to drive meaningful AI adoption across the organization.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, values intellectual curiosity, and wants to make a tangible impact on a global scale.

**Job Key Responsibilities**

* **Solutions Development \& Integration:** Design, develop, and deploy applications leveraging large language models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies to solve business challenges that are practical and applicable to the site, whilst collaborating closely with the global Operations transformation functions
* **Prompt Engineering:** Craft, test, and optimize prompts to maximize model performance; develop prompt engineering strategies that balance accuracy, efficiency, and user experience
* **Code Development:** Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following best practices and coding standards
* **Prototype \& Experimentation:** Build rapid prototypes to validate Physical (robotics) and GenAI concepts; conduct systematic experiments to measure effectiveness and iterate on solutions
* **Collaboration with Business Teams:** Work closely with strategy, operations, and business units to understand requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver scalable solutions that drive business value
* **AI Adoption \& Knowledge Sharing:** Champion and promote Physical and GenAI adoption across AbbVie; mentor colleagues, conduct training sessions, and share best practices to build organizational AI literacy
* **Framework \& Tool Evaluation:** Evaluate and implement modern AI frameworks and tools; stay current with emerging technologies and industry developments
* **Documentation \& Best Practices:** Maintain comprehensive documentation of AI solutions, methodologies, and lessons learned to support organizational knowledge management

**Job Responsibilities GMP**

* Support his/her supervisor in implementing projects for innovation, automation, and digital transformation in the manufacturing site, ensuring adherence to GMP regulations
* Collaborate with his/her supervisor in collecting, organizing relevant data where needed
* Support the configuration and implementation of dedicated tools for the optimization of processes through AI

**Description of Responsibilities GMP**

* + Supporting continuous improvement initiatives based on assigned activities
	+ Ensure all activities comply with GMP regulations
	+ Collect relevant process data
	+ Organize and input data into digital systems
	+ Report key data with the supervisor for decision making
	+ Planning meetings with cross\-functional teams
	+ Planning and monitoring the assigned activities/projects, proposing efficient solutions
	+ Preparing and maintaining relevant projects documentation and reports
	+ Identifying potential risks or issues and recommending mitigation actions with the support of the supervisor
	+ Analyze the processes to be improved via AI, proposing their optimization, with the support of the supervisor
	+ Implementing AI solutions for the assigned processes
	+ Participating in the test phases and troubleshooting of AI solutions

 **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
* 3\-4 years of professional experience
* Strong proficiency in AI coding with demonstrated ability to write production\-quality code
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools such as ChatGPT, OpenAI, Claude, or similar platforms
* Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals including model training, evaluation metrics, and deployment considerations
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Fluent English in both written and spoken.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or biotech technology sectors
* Expertise in prompt engineering libraries and techniques (e.g., LangChain, Anthropic Prompt Caching)
* Experience with software API development and integration
